description: This file contains unit tests for the AppStateRemoteConfig component of the OpenClaw application, specifically testing remote gateway configuration updates and token handling.

classes.name: AppStateRemoteConfigTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating remote gateway configuration behaviors in AppState.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that the remote configuration correctly trims whitespace from the token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Tests that the token is cleared when an input blank is provided.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that object tokens are preserved when switching modes or transports without modifications.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Checks that entering plaintext replaces the secret reference with the plaintext token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Verifies that the secret reference is maintained until explicitly cleared or modified.
